hypothesis: Published ground segmentation must be evaluated after sensor-height and tilt correction before rejection; exact synthetic floor labels reveal genuine classification errors.
note: Nine exact-label synthetic scenes span height and tilt. Real ground comparisons use residuals to the independently fitted local reference only, not ground accuracy. RNR is disabled because intensity semantics are not calibrated. Corridor variants restrict input to +/-3m and are scored only within that region. Main comparison scores every method on the identical leveled +/-3m corridor; per-input-domain scores are retained separately.
